title: A wildlife documentary has cast you as a rare animal
dek: No facts to memorise. Twelve questions about how you survive, hide and behave, and the crew will tell you which animal they drove eight hours to film.

questions.prompt: A field researcher finally spots you:

options.label: Regenerating something you lost last week
Rolling into a ball, immediately
Standing very still, looking like two animals
Screaming, at night, for no obvious reason
A cave nobody has finished mapping
Deep water, terrible pressure
High, dry, and a nightmare to reach
A forest at night, entirely alone
Hide so well that nobody confirms you exist
Be so strange that nobody can forget you
Still water, and something under it
options.alt: A slow river running past a quiet bank

options.label: Trees, and one shape that doesn't fit
options.alt: A dense forest with a narrow track

options.label: Too many stars and a small silhouette
options.alt: A night sky full of stars

options.label: Dry ground and a lot of nothing

questions.helper: Across: hide or display. Up: water or land.
First place is the one that has kept you alive so far.
Two gaps. The second one is what the locals actually say.
questions.template: The narration says {a}. The locals say {b}.

options.label: it can regrow almost anything
it is almost certainly extinct
it has a horn and no explanation
it was discovered entirely by accident
don't look at it directly
it screams at night, we've stopped asking
it's lucky, leave it alone
it's out there, we've seen the photos

questions.prompt: I would rather be stared at than understood.
Being rare is a personality, not a problem.
Being memorable matters more than being beautiful.
Your conservation status, according to you:

options.label: Critically endangered, and doing fine about it
Data deficient, which is the dream
Poached for something absurd
Nobody is counting

questions.prompt: The one true thing about you:

options.label: You grow back
You were here before the map
You make a sound nobody can place
You are stranger than the drawing

results.name: THE AXOLOTL
results.tagline: Never grows up, never stays broken
results.blurb: You regenerate. Not emotionally, exactly, but close enough: something gets taken from you and six weeks later there is a slightly different version of it in its place. You stay curious and un-serious in a way that people find either charming or suspicious, and you have outlasted things that should have finished you.
results.watchOut: Regrowing is not healing. Look at the thing that happened.

results.name: THE PANGOLIN
results.tagline: Rolls up, waits you out, says nothing
results.blurb: Your entire strategy is defence, and it works. You go quiet, you go small, you let the situation exhaust itself, and you come out the other side exactly as you were. People find you hard to read. That is not an accident; it is the whole armour.
results.watchOut: You roll up for things that only needed a conversation. Unroll earlier.

results.name: THE OKAPI
results.tagline: Half one thing, half another, entirely unconfirmed
results.blurb: You are the person people describe badly because there is nothing to compare you to. You keep to the deep forest, you are seen rarely, and every sighting becomes a story. You are not mysterious on purpose. You are just genuinely unlike the categories available.
results.watchOut: You are so rarely seen that people fill in the gaps. Show up occasionally.

results.name: THE KAKAPO
results.tagline: Cannot fly, will not stop trying
results.blurb: You are ridiculous, endangered and beloved, and you have absolutely no idea how precarious you are. You climb things you cannot get down from, you make a noise at 3am that alarms the neighbours, and an entire team of people has quietly rearranged their lives to keep you going.
strengths: Fearless to the point of comedy
results.watchOut: You rely on other people's patience more than you notice. Say thank you.

results.name: THE SAIGA ANTELOPE
results.tagline: Built wrong for this climate, still here
results.blurb: You have an unusual nose, an unusual approach and a talent for surviving conditions that should have finished you off. You migrate when it gets bad, you do not advertise, and you have been doing this for a very long time without anyone writing it down.
results.watchOut: You adapt to bad situations instead of leaving them. Sometimes leave.

results.name: THE NARWHAL
results.blurb: You have one unmistakable quality and everyone has built a mythology around it. You are calmer about this than they are. Under the ice, in the dark, with people you trust, you are entirely ordinary, which is somehow the most surprising thing about you.
results.watchOut: You let the legend do the work. Be a person, not a story.

results.name: THE OLM
results.tagline: Lives in the dark, outlives the light
results.blurb: You are adapted to a situation most people would call unliveable: low light, no company, very little happening. You can go a long time without food, attention or answers. When you do surface, people are startled by how strange and how old you seem.
results.watchOut: You can survive in the dark so well that you forget to come out. Surface.

results.name: THE TARSIER
results.tagline: Enormous eyes, no interest in being perceived
results.blurb: You notice everything and reveal nothing. Your whole thing is observation: wide-eyed, silent, slightly unnerving to be on the receiving end of. You are much stronger and much faster than your size suggests, and you would prefer people kept their distance about it.
results.watchOut: You watch instead of participating. Join in before the scene ends.

results.name: THE BLOB FISH
results.blurb: You look completely different at your own depth. Pulled out of your environment and photographed badly, you are a meme. At home, under pressure nobody else can survive, you are a perfectly normal, quite elegant creature who would like everyone to stop commenting on the face.
strengths: Better in context than in photos
results.watchOut: You let one unflattering version of you become the whole story. Correct it.

results.name: THE KIWI
results.tagline: Awake at the wrong hour, doing the work
results.blurb: You function best when nobody is watching: late, quietly, in the dark, doing something unglamorous that holds everything together. You cannot fly, you cannot see especially well, and yet you are still here after everyone more impressive has gone to bed.
results.watchOut: You do your best work when nobody sees it, then wonder why nobody sees it.
